title: Minimum Number of Pushes to Type Word I
summary: Given a string containing distinct lowercase English letters, determine the minimum number of key presses required to type the string after remapping the keys numbered 2 to 9 to distinct collections of letters.
statement: Given a string containing distinct lowercase English letters, determine the minimum number of key presses required to type the string after remapping the keys numbered 2 to 9 to distinct collections of letters. Each letter must be mapped to exactly one key. The initial letter mappings for keys 2 through 9 are provided, and you need to find the optimal remapping to minimize the total number of key presses.
constraints: Assign the distinct letters of word to eight telephone keys.
The first letter assigned to a key costs one push, the second costs two, and so on.
Every character in this version appears once; return the minimum total pushes.
reference_solution:
def minimum_keypad_pushes(word):
    return sum(index//8+1 for index in range(len(word)))
hints: Use all eight one-push positions before any two-push position.
Because letters occur once, their identities do not affect cost.
The zero-based assignment index has cost floor(index/8)+1.
Filling shallower positions first is optimal by exchange: moving any letter from a deeper open slot to a shallower one reduces cost.

tests.explanation: Five letters fit in first positions and require five pushes.
Eight letters cost one push and two additional letters cost two each, totaling twelve.
